audience: mailing teams that send physical letters and verify postal addresses with PostGrid

useCases.title: Verify a US or Canadian postal address
useCases.text: Send an address to check it. Read the corrected address and its status. Each check uses one PostGrid lookup.

useCases.title: Save a recipient to the address book
useCases.text: List the saved contacts to avoid duplicates. Save a postal contact, and PostGrid verifies its address.

useCases.title: Track letters and their status
useCases.text: List letters with their status, mailing class and send date. Open one letter to read its tracking data.

useCases.title: Send a letter from a saved template
useCases.text: Read a saved template and its merge placeholders. Send a letter from it. Test keys send nothing; live keys print and mail the letter.

useCases.title: Cancel a letter before it prints
useCases.text: Check the letter status first. Cancel a letter that is not yet printing, with a short note for the audit trail.
